text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. It's a lovely morning... I 
can feel the scent of the season soaking 
deep into my body.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Since it's a rare day off, I 
decided to research the perfect schedule 
to wind down before sleep.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Light aerobic exercise in the evening, a 
full-body stretch, warm milk, and an ideal 
bedtime—thanks to all that, I was able to 
get some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I believe I had a wonderful day off— Thank 
you very much.
